title: EMT: An OS Framework for New Memory Translation Architectures
problem: Emerging memory translation architectures (beyond traditional page-based virtual memory) lack OS-level support, limiting their adoption and performance optimization in systems.
motivation: OS framework support for novel memory translation mechanisms enables efficient deployment of emerging memory architectures.
method: EMT provides a flexible OS abstraction layer that supports diverse memory translation architectures, including non-traditional page tables and alternative translation schemes.
key_novelty: Operating system framework abstracting and supporting multiple memory translation architectures.
contributions: Flexible OS abstraction for diverse memory translation schemes
Backwards compatibility with traditional virtual memory
limitations: Generalization to diverse memory architectures; performance overhead of abstraction layer.
